_comment: Defaults for collect.py. Command-line options override these. Relative paths are relative to this file; ~ and $VARS are expanded. copilotHomes [] = $COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot. out null = stdout; e.g. "../../reports/copilot-cli.json". excludeClients: client_name globs to skip (JetBrains AI Assistant and Copilot-plugin sessions are reported by collectors/intellij). vscodeUserDirs [] = auto-detect VS Code (its agent-host.db marks CLI sessions opened from VS Code). Note: a file path here also receives --format tree output unless you pass --out -.
